lead.headline: Flores quake toll climbs to 51 as thousands leave home
lead.dek: Indonesia counts 341 aftershocks two days after a magnitude 7.7 struck off the island
body: At least 51 people are dead and about 5,000 displaced after a magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia early Saturday, Al Jazeera reported, citing the national disaster agency. The toll has more than doubled since Saturday morning.

The quake hit at 5:58 a.m. local time about 68 kilometers north-northwest of Ende at a depth of 10 kilometers, the U.S. Geological Survey said. Thirty-six people were seriously hurt and 77 slightly. It flattened 157 houses and damaged some 1,300 more.
More than 3,500 military and police have deployed and the government is weighing a state of emergency. A quake in the same waters in 1992 killed more than 2,500 people.

briefs.headline: Hurricane Lala closes on Hawaii's Big Island
briefs.summary: Lala reached Category 1 with 75 mph winds, the island's first direct hit in 155 years. Gov. Josh Green told residents to shelter.

briefs.headline: Indiana flooding kills at least 5
briefs.summary: The White River crested above 24 feet at Anderson, past the 1913 record, after 11 inches of rain in two days.

briefs.headline: Trump says the USS Lincoln tour is not long enough
briefs.summary: Asked Friday whether the nine-month deployment ran too long, Trump said it was "not nearly long enough."

briefs.headline: Memo would let U.S. firms hack foreign cybercriminals
briefs.summary: A memorandum issued Aug. 14 lets vetted companies disrupt networks of designated foreign groups, subject to vetting and a bond.

briefs.headline: Israeli strikes kill 11 in southern Lebanon
briefs.summary: Strikes on Ansar and Deir al-Zahrani killed 11, three of them children, the Health Ministry said. It is the deadliest day since the June truce.

briefs.headline: Bus crash on a Hungarian motorway kills 12
briefs.summary: A Polish coach carrying 57 overturned on the M3 near Mezokeresztes about 1 a.m. Police said the driver likely fell asleep.

briefs.headline: Ukraine sends about 600 drones at Moscow
briefs.summary: Moscow's mayor said 201 were destroyed over the region and an 83-year-old man killed. Russian strikes on Kryvyi Rih killed a woman.

briefs.headline: CAMC settles unnecessary-surgery suit for $40M
briefs.summary: The class covers more than 4,000 patients given hernia repairs during bariatric surgery. Two surgeons named in the 2025 filing have left the hospital.

briefs.headline: Justices close a $500M Greenbrier joint venture
briefs.summary: Kennedy Lewis Investment Management takes 51% and the 90-job casino stays open. The Lottery Commission votes Aug. 26 on the new board.

briefs.headline: Detector reads a reactor that is switched off
briefs.summary: Double Chooz logged about 100 antineutrinos over 17.2 days with both units offline, from decay in the cores and pools.
briefs.source: Max Planck Institute for Nuclear Physics

briefs.headline: Superconducting circuit runs as a quantum heat engine
briefs.summary: A qubit, a resonator and a quantum refrigerator ran repeated Otto cycles near absolute zero, in Nature Communications.

briefs.headline: Ant and bee genetics fail to explain their colonies
briefs.summary: Across nearly 69,000 insect species, haplodiploidy predicted eusociality only among ants, bees and stinging wasps.

briefs.headline: Osaka rock yields 4 bones of a Cretaceous sea lizard
briefs.summary: Bones collected near Kaizuka City in 1990-92 sat in rock 30 years, and include a first premaxilla for a Japanese mosasaur.
